PublicVerifyOut.description:
GET /verify/{report_id} -- public, unauthenticated. Minimal safe
fields only: never the worker's name/contact, never evidence, never the
full score breakdown. `valid` distinguishes "signature verifies against
a trusted key" from `status`, which is always SIGNED here (a report row
only ever exists once signed) -- the two are deliberately separate
fields so a caller can't misread "status: SIGNED" as itself a validity
guarantee.
PublicVerifyOut.title: PublicVerifyOut

get.description:
Assessor/admin only -- the full, append-only accountability trail for
one assessment (who did what, when), including P6's sync-specific
actions (manifest received/rejected, cross-check mismatches, package
completion) alongside the P2.2 lifecycle/scoring/decision/report/token
actions. Oldest first, matching the order things actually happened.

Dual auth, same as GET /assessments/{id} -- assessor/admin JWT, or

Photos serve their own bytes directly (no separate thumbnail job --
see models.EvidenceItem.thumbnail_status's 'not_applicable' default).
Videos serve the ffmpeg-extracted frame once the background job
completes; while queued, or if ffmpeg extraction failed/is unavailable,
this is a graceful 404 (never a 500) so the dashboard can show a
pending/placeholder state instead of crashing.

post.description:
Assessor/admin only. Reopens exactly the requested tasks under a new
revision; every other task's v1 evidence/scores are untouched. Only one
reassessment request may be pending at a time (the server-side source
of truth for 'which tasks are reopened' would otherwise be ambiguous
while a prior request's revision is still unresolved).

get.description:
Protected -- same dual auth as GET /assessments/{id}. Serves the
STORED immutable artifact, never a re-render. format=receipt is the
detached signature bundle tools/verify_report.py needs alongside the
PDF -- fetched through this same authenticated channel (never the
public /verify/{report_id} endpoint, which deliberately omits the raw
signature) so an operator always gets it from a source they already
trust, never an arbitrary untrusted bundle.

post.description:
Password-confirmed final sign-off: records the assessor's final
recommendation (optionally overriding the computed one, with a mandatory
reason) and produces the one, immutable, Ed25519-signed PDF for this
assessment. Idempotent -- a retry after the first success returns the
exact same signed artifact, never resigns. Never logs/stores the
password itself.

An assessor picks a submitted assessment off the queue -- moves
submitted -> in_review and claims it (assessor_id).

The worker app calls this once it's done capturing evidence for all
five tasks -- moves draft -> submitted and LOCKS further evidence
uploads (see routers/uploads.py's require_draft checks). Worker-token
authenticated, same as uploads -- there is no worker login.

get.description:
P6: consolidated begin/recover + per-item status, so the phone's
WorkManager worker (and the dashboard) can learn, in one call, exactly
which declared items are missing/uploading/verified/rejected for a
revision -- used to resolve a possibly-lost acknowledgement via server
status rather than blindly re-uploading, and to decide which chunks (if
any) are actually missing before resuming.

`revision_id` is optional and defaults to the assessment's current
(most recently ACCEPTED) revision -- but the phone always knows its own
revision_id locally (from Room) and should pass it explicitly to check
on a revision that was outright REJECTED (which never becomes
"current"), e.g. right after a failed sync attempt.

post.description:
No new token is issued -- every worker-token-authenticated endpoint
(uploads, submit, GET, report download) rejects it from this point on,
regardless of whether the hash would otherwise still match.

Invalidates the current token immediately (the old raw value stops
working the instant this commits -- its hash is simply overwritten) and
issues a fresh one, returned once, exactly like at creation. Use when a
worker's device is lost or a token may have leaked.

get.description:
Durable, idempotent snapshot for the worker app to poll: the latest
PENDING reassessment request (if any), current status, and report
availability. A deliberate, documented departure from the master
plan's literal 'GET /workers/me/updates?since=' shape -- see
docs/gates/P7.md section 3 for why (no worker login/session concept
exists to make 'me' meaningful; this is scoped by the same
per-assessment capability token every other worker-facing endpoint
already uses). `since` is advisory only (lets a caller skip re-fetching
unchanged `pending_reassessment_request` details); the response always
reflects current DB state, so a replayed/duplicate poll is always safe.

Submitted (or further-along) assessments waiting on an assessor,
oldest first. Assessor/admin only -- see server/app/auth.py. Scoring,
decisions, reassessment and signed reports all exist (P2.2) and are
reached from here via GET /assessments/{id} -- this endpoint itself
stays a plain queue listing, not a scored summary.

Public, unauthenticated -- kept for backward compatibility (looks up
by the internal assessment_id). See GET /verify/{report_id} for the
new, stable-public-id version the signed PDF's QR code actually points
at.
